data: Which line corresponds to the system trained with "Full Expert" annotations?

The caption states that the figure shows parsing accuracy on the Spider Dev set when systems are trained with various numbers of user/expert annotations and for different iterations. The question asks which line corresponds to the system trained with "Full Expert" annotations.

Looking at the graph, there are four lines represented by different colors and patterns:
- Blue line: Full Expert
- Red line: MISP-NEIL
- Brown line: MISP-NEIL*
- Yellow line: Self Train

The blue line is labeled "Full Expert," so this line corresponds to the system trained with "Full Expert" annotations.
